queries_run: Plexus Corp tariffs China export controls earnings call 2026

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露：墨西哥廠在 IMMEX 保稅計畫下營運（降低關稅），計畫變動或不合規會造成不利影響；關稅、出口管制與貿易保護措施可能影響成本、零組件供應與需求。
findings.excerpt: Our current facilities in Mexico operate under the Mexican Maquiladora (“IMMEX”) program. This program provides for reduced tariffs and eased import regulations. We could be adversely affected by changes in the IMMEX program or our failure to comply with its requirements.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露：出口規範與制裁可能限制在中國使用或生產特定技術／產品，或銷售最終運往中國的零組件；貿易法規涉及先進半導體，可能限制對中國客戶出貨、支援中國營運專案與採購零組件。
findings.excerpt: Changing export regulations, increasing sanctions or other trade barriers may limit our ability to use or produce certain technologies or products in China or sell certain components or products that are ultimately destined to China.

findings.claim: 10-K FY2025 揭露：客戶合約多允許季度性價格調整，但公司過去及未來可能承擔調價之間的零組件漲價風險，回收調價對營業利益率有稀釋效果。
findings.excerpt: While many of our customers permit quarterly or other periodic adjustments to pricing based on changes in component prices and other factors, we have in the past and may continue to bear the risk of price increases that occur between any such repricing or, if such repricing is not permitted, during the balance of the term of the particular customer contract.

note: 2026 年公司專屬關稅／出口管制揭露搜尋未見；兩次搜尋僅得一般 Section 232 資訊，無 Plexus 專屬來源。
